problem: A valid quotation about a qualitative evaluation is generalized to the whole math comparison while a quantitative follow-up is omitted.
observed_claim: The math comparison is very small and qualitative, so its results provide only weak grounds for broad claims of competitiveness.

source_evidence.quote: We use two level-5 problems from the MATH dataset for the qualitative evaluation and test on each problem for 3 times.
With one trial, AutoGen scores 8/12 problems

observed_path: Decision seq 10 reads pages 8-10; seq 15 then reads pages 15-17. The final observation cites page 10. The next-page quantitative follow-up is not incorporated in that criticism.
expected: Distinguish the two-problem qualitative comparison from the twelve-problem quantitative follow-up. It remains reasonable to question sample size and single-trial uncertainty without claiming the entire comparison is qualitative.
root_cause: The source and trace establish incomplete evidence coverage and an overbroad claim. Whether the omission arose from the reading policy, context use, or a model tendency is not isolated by this run.
certainty: The discrepancy is directly visible in frozen page text. The existing model audit independently labels the observation overstated at seq 38; neither analysis is a human gold label or a frequency estimate.
m3_protocol: Count the end-to-end incidence on repeated T03 runs and independently label review coverage and calibration. Keep this disclosed historical failure separate from a previously unseen quality test.
